values.content:
={{ `You are checking whether Wikimedia Commons or Openverse images show the requested subjects for a multi-slide story.

Story context: ${$('Get Next Story').first().json.Title}

Slides and their candidate pools (JSON array; use pageid to refer to candidates):
${JSON.stringify($json.compactSlides)}

For EACH slide, choose the single candidate that best shows the requested subject: the object/scene itself, recognisable, and not a different model or unrelated object. Avoid picking the same pageid for two different slides when another valid candidate exists. Person-led images are allowed if relevant. Reject font diagrams, schematics, and illustrations unless the subject is the illustration itself.

Rate confidence per slide:
- high: title or description clearly identifies the requested subject.
- medium: plausibly the subject but not confirmed by metadata.
- low: unrelated, wrong model, or cannot tell.

If none match for a slide, return chosen_pageid null with confidence low.

Return ONLY JSON: {"choices": [{"slide_index": 1, "chosen_pageid": 123 or null, "confidence": "high|medium|low", "reason": "one sentence"}]}` }}

parameters.jsCode:
const s=$input.first().json;const choices=$('Collect Choices').all().map(x=>x.json);const bad=choices.filter(c=>!['selected','text_only'].includes(c.result));const flags=(s.Flags||'').split(';').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(bad.length&&!flags.includes('image needs review'))flags.push('image needs review');const log='WF3c '+new Date().toISOString()+'
'+choices.map(c=>'Slide '+c.slide_index+': '+c.subject+' — '+c.result+' ('+c.confidence+'): '+c.reason).join('
');return [{json:{id:s.id,Flags:flags.join('; '),'Reviewer Notes':(s['Reviewer Notes']?s['Reviewer Notes']+'

':'')+log}}];

return $('Collect Choices').all().filter(x=>x.json.result==='selected'||x.json.result==='needs_review'||(!x.json.chosen&&x.json.aiFallbackPrompt&&x.json.result!=='text_only')).map((x,i)=>({json:x.json,pairedItem:{item:0}}));

parameters.jsCode: const out=[];for(const [i,x]of $input.all().entries()){const m=$('Needs AI Generation?').itemMatching(i).json;const b=await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(i,'data');if(!/^image\//.test(x.binary?.data?.mimeType||'')||b.length<=10240||!(b[0]===0xff&&b[1]===0xd8)&&!(b[0]===0x89&&b[1]===0x50)&&!(b.toString('ascii',0,4)==='RIFF')&&!(b.toString('ascii',0,2)==='II')&&!(b.toString('ascii',0,2)==='MM'))throw new Error('Download verification failed for slide '+m.slide_index+': '+(x.binary?.data?.mimeType||'missing MIME')+', '+b.length+' bytes');out.push({json:{...m,localPath:'/Users/admin/Documents/My Workspace/we-humanity-wf3c/assets/'+$('Get Next Story').first().json.id+'_slide_'+m.slide_index+'.'+(x.binary.data.fileExtension||'jpg')},binary:x.binary,pairedItem:{item:i}});}return out;
return $input.all().map((x,i)=>({json:{...x.json,chosen:null,confidence:'low',reason:'No licensed matching image candidates were found.',result:'no_candidates'},pairedItem:{item:i}}));
return $input.all().map((x,i)=>({json:{...$('Capture Image Failure').itemMatching(i).json,imageFailed:true},pairedItem:{item:i}}));
return $input.all().flatMap((x,i)=>!x.json.imageFailed&&x.binary?.data?[{json:x.json,binary:x.binary,pairedItem:{item:i}}]:[]);
